name: restful-booker-performance-tests
description: Performance testing of the Restful-Booker API with k6, TypeScript and Docker: load, stress, spike, soak and breakpoint tests with SLO thresholds and published reports.
author: Francisco Varela

scripts.test:smoke: docker compose run --rm k6 run tests/smoke.ts
scripts.test:load: docker compose run --rm -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=reports/load-report.html k6 run tests/load.ts
scripts.test:stress: docker compose run --rm -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=reports/stress-report.html k6 run tests/stress.ts
scripts.test:spike: docker compose run --rm -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=reports/spike-report.html k6 run tests/spike.ts
scripts.test:soak: docker compose run --rm -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=reports/soak-report.html k6 run tests/soak.ts
scripts.test:breakpoint: docker compose run --rm -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=reports/breakpoint-report.html k6 run tests/breakpoint.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
